headline: Seduta in prevalenza negativa a Wall Street: Sandisk +11,90% guida i rialzi
headline_en: Broadly negative session on Wall Street: Sandisk +11.90% leads gainers

paragraphs: Nella seduta del 4 settembre 2026 l'S&P 500 ha chiuso con 175 societa' in rialzo, 327 in ribasso e 1 invariate, su 503 titoli monitorati. La variazione media dell'indice e' stata di -0,43%.

Settori con la variazione media migliore: Industrials (+0,28%); Information Technology (+0,20%); Utilities (+0,08%). Settori piu' debolli: Communication Services (-1,55%); Health Care (-0,92%); Financials (-0,87%).

In cima alla seduta: Sandisk (SNDK, +11,90%); KLA Corporation (KLAC, +7,32%); Marvell Technology (MRVL, +7,05%). In fondo: Lululemon Athletica (LULU, -17,38%); Fair Isaac (FICO, -16,68%); Autodesk (ADSK, -8,26%).

en: In the September 4, 2026 session the S&P 500 closed with 175 stocks higher, 327 lower and 1 unchanged, out of 503 tracked. The average move was -0.43%.

Best-performing sectors by average move: Industrials (+0.28%); Information Technology (+0.20%); Utilities (+0.08%). Weakest: Communication Services (-1.55%); Health Care (-0.92%); Financials (-0.87%).

Leading the session: Sandisk (SNDK, +11.90%); KLA Corporation (KLAC, +7.32%); Marvell Technology (MRVL, +7.05%). At the bottom: Lululemon Athletica (LULU, -17.38%); Fair Isaac (FICO, -16.68%); Autodesk (ADSK, -8.26%).
